passages.text: Hallelujah! Praise the name of the LORD. Give praise, O servants of the LORD, who stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God.
passages.sermon:
Hallelujah.
Praise the name of the LORD.
Servants of the LORD, praise Him.
You stand in the house of the LORD.
You stand in the courts of the house of our God.
passages.original: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ׀ הַֽ֭לְלוּ אֶת־ שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה הַֽ֝לְלוּ עַבְדֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ שֶׁ֣֭עֹֽמְדִים בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה בְּ֝חַצְר֗וֹת בֵּ֣ית אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

passages.text: Hallelujah, for the LORD is good; sing praises to His name, for it is lovely.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is good.
His name is lovely.
Praise the LORD.
Sing praises to His name.
passages.original: הַֽ֭לְלוּ־ יָהּ כִּי־ ט֣וֹב יְהוָ֑ה זַמְּר֥וּ לִ֝שְׁמ֗וֹ כִּ֣י נָעִֽים׃

passages.text: For the LORD has chosen Jacob as His own, Israel as His treasured possession.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD chose Jacob.
Jacob is also called Israel.
The LORD made Israel His own people.
Israel is the LORD’s treasured possession.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ יַעֲקֹ֗ב בָּחַ֣ר ל֣וֹ יָ֑הּ יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל לִסְגֻלָּתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: For I know that the LORD is great; our Lord is above all gods.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is great.
He is our Lord.
He is above all gods.
I know this.
passages.original: כִּ֤י אֲנִ֣י יָ֭דַעְתִּי כִּי־ גָד֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה וַ֝אֲדֹנֵ֗ינוּ מִכָּל־ אֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: The LORD does all that pleases Him in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and in all their depths.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD is great.
The LORD is above all gods.
The LORD does whatever He wants.
He acts in the heavens.
He acts on the earth.
He acts in the seas.
He acts in all the deep places.
passages.original: כֹּ֤ל אֲשֶׁר־ חָפֵ֥ץ יְהוָ֗ה עָ֫שָׂ֥ה בַּשָּׁמַ֥יִם וּבָאָ֑רֶץ בַּ֝יַּמִּ֗ים וְכָל־ תְּהוֹמֽוֹת׃

passages.text: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is great.
The LORD is above all gods.
The LORD acts as He pleases in heaven and on earth.
The LORD acts in the seas and in all their depths.
The LORD causes clouds to rise from the ends of the earth.
The LORD makes lightning with the rain.
The LORD brings out the wind from His storehouses.
passages.original: מַֽעֲלֶ֣ה נְשִׂאִים֮ מִקְצֵ֪ה הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ בְּרָקִ֣ים לַמָּטָ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה מֽוֹצֵא־ ר֝וּחַ מֵאֽוֹצְרוֹתָֽיו׃

passages.text: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, of both man and beast.
passages.sermon:
The LORD acted with power in Egypt.
He struck down the firstborn in Egypt.
He struck down the firstborn among people.
He struck down the firstborn among animals.
passages.original: שֶֽׁ֭הִכָּה בְּכוֹרֵ֣י מִצְרָ֑יִם מֵ֝אָדָ֗ם עַד־ בְּהֵמָֽה׃

passages.text: He sent signs and wonders into your midst, O Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.
passages.sermon:
God acted in Egypt.
God sent signs into Egypt.
God sent wonders into Egypt.
God did these things among the Egyptians.
God acted against Pharaoh.
God acted against all Pharaoh’s servants.
passages.original: שָׁלַ֤ח׀ אֹת֣וֹת וּ֭מֹפְתִים בְּתוֹכֵ֣כִי מִצְרָ֑יִם בְּ֝פַרְעֹ֗ה וּבְכָל־ עֲבָדָֽיו׃

passages.text: He struck down many nations and slaughtered mighty kings: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kings of Canaan.
passages.sermon:
God acted with great power.
God struck down many nations.
God killed mighty kings.
God defeated Sihon.
Sihon was king of the Amorites.
God defeated Og.
Og was king of Bashan.
God defeated all the kings of Canaan.
passages.original: שֶֽׁ֭הִכָּה גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֑ים וְ֝הָרַ֗ג מְלָכִ֥ים עֲצוּמִֽים׃ לְסִיח֤וֹן׀ מֶ֤לֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִ֗י וּ֭לְעוֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֑ן וּ֝לְכֹ֗ל מַמְלְכ֥וֹת כְּנָֽעַן׃

passages.text: He gave their land as an inheritance, as a heritage to His people Israel.
passages.sermon:
God acted with power.
God took the land from the nations.
God gave this land to His people.
God made the land an inheritance for Israel.
God gave Israel a heritage.
passages.original: וְנָתַ֣ן אַרְצָ֣ם נַחֲלָ֑ה נַ֝חֲלָ֗ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל עַמּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Your name, O LORD, endures forever, Your renown, O LORD, through all generations.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
His name lasts forever.
People remember the LORD in every generation.
His fame continues through all time.
passages.original: יְ֭הוָה שִׁמְךָ֣ לְעוֹלָ֑ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה זִכְרְךָ֥ לְדֹר־ וָדֹֽר׃

passages.text: For the LORD will vindicate His people and will have compassion on His servants.
passages.sermon: The LORD is the God of Israel.\r\nThe LORD will judge His people.\r\nThe LORD will show compassion to His servants.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ יָדִ֣ין יְהוָ֣ה עַמּ֑וֹ וְעַל־ עֲ֝בָדָ֗יו יִתְנֶחָֽם׃

passages.text: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.
passages.sermon: The nations have idols.\r\nThese idols are silver and gold.\r\nPeople make these idols with their own hands.
passages.original: עֲצַבֵּ֣י הַ֭גּוֹיִם כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֑ב מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗ה יְדֵ֣י אָדָֽם׃

passages.text: They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see; they have ears, but cannot hear; nor is there breath in their mouths.
passages.sermon:
The idols of the nations are silver and gold.
People make these idols with their own hands.
These idols have mouths.
But these idols cannot speak.
These idols have eyes.
But these idols cannot see.
These idols have ears.
But these idols cannot hear.
There is no breath in the mouths of these idols.
passages.original: פֶּֽה־ לָ֭הֶם וְלֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ עֵינַ֥יִם לָ֝הֶ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יִרְאֽוּ׃ אָזְנַ֣יִם לָ֭הֶם וְלֹ֣א יַאֲזִ֑ינוּ אַ֝֗ף אֵין־ יֶשׁ־ ר֥וּחַ בְּפִיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.
passages.sermon:
Idols are silver and gold.
People make these idols with their hands.
Idols cannot speak.
Idols cannot see.
Idols cannot hear.
Idols have no breath in their mouths.
People who make idols become like the idols.
People who trust in idols also become like the idols.
passages.original: כְּ֭מוֹהֶם יִהְי֣וּ עֹשֵׂיהֶ֑ם כֹּ֭ל אֲשֶׁר־ בֹּטֵ֣חַ בָּהֶֽם׃

passages.text: O house of Israel, bless the LORD; O house of Aaron, bless the LORD; O house of Levi, bless the LORD; you who fear the LORD, bless the LORD!
passages.sermon:
The house of Israel must bless the LORD.
The house of Aaron must bless the LORD.
The house of Levi must bless the LORD.
All who fear the LORD must bless the LORD.
passages.original: בֵּ֣ית יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל בָּרֲכ֣וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה בֵּ֥ית אַ֝הֲרֹ֗ן בָּרֲכ֥וּ אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃ בֵּ֣ית הַ֭לֵּוִי בָּרֲכ֣וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה יִֽרְאֵ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה בָּרֲכ֥וּ אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Blessed be the LORD from Zion— He who dwells in Jerusalem. Hallelujah!
passages.sermon:
The LORD is blessed.
He is in Zion.
He lives in Jerusalem.
Praise the LORD.
passages.original: בָּ֘ר֤וּךְ יְהוָ֨ה׀ מִצִּיּ֗וֹן שֹׁ֘כֵ֤ן יְֽרוּשָׁלִָ֗ם הַֽלְלוּ־ יָֽהּ׃
